q: (the trumpet will be blown to signal the Day of Qiyaamah,)
v.s: When the sky has split [open]
v.c: When the sky bursts open,

v.s: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
v.c: obeying its Lord as it must,

q: the earth will be stretched out
v.s: And when the earth has been extended
v.c: and when the earth is flattened out,

q: ...and, casting out whatever is within, it will become empty.''
v.s: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it].
v.c: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty,

v.s: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
v.c: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺.

q: O man, indeed you make great efforts in your journey
(the Aakhirah where you will meet with)
your Rabb and will soon meet with
v.s: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
v.c: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences.
v.h: Fate of the Faithful and the Wicked

q: As for him who is given his record
v.s: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
v.c: As for those who are given their record in their right hand,

q: ...an easy reckoning will be taken from him
v.s: He will be judged with an easy account
v.c: they will have an easy reckoning,

q: he will return happily to his family
v.s: And return to his people in happiness.
v.c: and will return to their people joyfully.

q: As for him who is given his record
(of his actions in his left hand from)
(because even the angels will not want to look at him)...
v.s: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
v.c: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs,

q: (his death so that he may not have to suffer punishment).
v.s: He will cry out for destruction
v.c: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction,

q: (However, his pleas will be in vain because)
He will enter the Blazing Fire
v.s: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
v.c: and will burn in the blazing Fire.

v.s: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
v.c: For they used to be prideful among their people,

q: He used to think that he would not return
(to account for his actions before Allaah on the Day
v.s: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to God].
v.c: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺.

q: Verily his Rabb was ever Watchful over him
(seeing every evil action although he was not taken to task for it).
v.s: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
v.c: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them.

v.s: So I swear by the twilight glow
v.c: So, I do swear by the twilight!

v.s: And [by] the night and what it envelops
v.c: And by the night and whatever it envelops!

q: ...and by the moon when it is full
v.s: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
v.c: And by the moon when it waxes full!

q: will certainly proceed from phase to phase.
(From this world, man proceeds to the realm of “Barzakh” and then towards Qiyaamah and the many stages of the Aakhirah.)
v.s: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.
v.c: You will certainly pass from one state to another.

q: What is the matter with them
that they do not have Imaan...
v.s: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
v.c: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe,

q: ...and do not prostrate when the Qur'aan is recited to them?
(One who recites or hears this verse being recited should perform Sajdah.)
v.s: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to God]?
v.c: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺?

v.s: But those who have disbelieved deny,
v.c: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial.

q: Allaah is well Aware of whatever
v.s: And God is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
v.c: But Allah knows best whatever they hide.

q: give them the good news of a painful punishment...
v.s: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
v.c: So give them good news of a painful punishment.

q: have Imaan and carry out good acts. Theirs shall be an unending reward
v.s: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
v.c: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward.
